items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Recommendation: maintain containment for security-sensitive releases and new public exposure; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, detailed TLS posture, data exposure, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is mixed at 35/61 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown. This is risk triage, not a penetration test or certification. Do not claim compromise or a clean bill of health.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed fleet security disposition and containment gates
items.summary: Fleet-wide security clearance is unsupported because fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results and material controls remain unevidenced. Preserve private launch gates for security-sensitive releases and new public exposure while allowing bounded reversible growth that does not expand authority, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.
items.requested_action: Continue one consolidated read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence, affected scope, owners, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release and deploy controls, TLS, dependency and supply-chain risk, data exposure, incident signals, monitoring, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or claim certification.
